body.title: Contacts - Fieldnote API Reference
body.body:
Fieldnote API Reference
Authentication: send your API key in the X-Fieldnote-Key header.
GET /v2/contacts - list contacts (query: page, per_page, updated_since)
POST /v2/contacts - create a contact (body: email, first_name, last_name, company_id)
GET /v2/contacts/{id} - retrieve a contact
PATCH /v2/contacts/{id} - update a contact
DELETE /v2/contacts/{id} - delete a contact

body.title: Deals - Fieldnote API Reference
body.body:
Deals
GET /v2/deals - list deals
POST /v2/deals - create a deal (body: title, value, currency, stage_id, contact_id)
POST /v2/deals/{id}/won - mark a deal as won
Webhooks: POST /v2/webhooks with target_url and events[]

expect.offline: trigger.items override the template's pinned research event (Formstack); the template ships without credentials on every node but Get All Research (Apify header auth, Gemini, Qdrant, the other Sheets nodes), so the bench must attach them by type; the Qdrant URL is a stand-in (localhost:6333). Research, Extract and Generate call this workflow (executeWorkflow on itself) and are left unlisted (validate warns). Scrape Webpage Contents batches 2 requests per 30 s, so the run takes 30 s more per extra pair. Apify result shapes follow the template's expressions (origin_search.results[].type and source.link; body and url from the page function)
